All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
CsvInventoryRepository
Stores the inventory in a UTF-8 CSV file, data/inventory.csv by default.
DashedRule
Horizontal dashed divider, used to separate sections on a slip.
DuplicateItemException
Thrown when an item name is already used by another item.
EmptyStatePanel
Panel shown in place of the ledger table when there is nothing to list.
InputValidator
Parses and validates the raw text the user types for an item.
InvalidItemException
Thrown when item input fails validation.
InvalidItemException.Field
The item input fields that can fail validation.
InventoryData
Everything needed to save and restore an inventory: the items and the ID to give the next new item.
InventoryException
Base class for every checked exception raised by the inventory system.
InventoryGUI
Main window of Stockroom, laid out as a stockroom ledger.
InventoryGUI.LedgerRowFilter
Row filter that keeps rows whose item matched the search and has the chosen status.
InventoryListener
Observer that is told whenever the inventory changes.
InventoryManager
Holds every item in the inventory and carries out operations on them.
InventoryRepository
Storage for the inventory, so it survives between runs.
Item
A single inventory item recorded in the stockroom ledger.
ItemNotFoundException
Thrown when an operation refers to an item ID that is not in the inventory.
ItemTableModel
Table model that presents a list of Items as ledger rows.
LedgerButton
Square, custom-painted button in the Stockroom Ledger style.
LedgerButton.Variant
Visual variants of a LedgerButton.
LedgerCellRenderer
Plain-text table cell renderer for the ledger: line numbers, IDs, names and numbers, each in its own style.
LedgerCellRenderer.Kind
Cell styles drawn by LedgerCellRenderer.
LedgerHeaderRenderer
Column header renderer for the ledger table.
LedgerScrollBarUI
Scroll bar look for the ledger: a slim, square thumb on the paper background with no arrow buttons, replacing the default Metal scroll bar.
LedgerTable
Ledger table that can briefly flash a row orange, used to point out a newly added entry.
LevelBarRenderer
Table cell renderer for the quantity column: a right-aligned mono numeral with a thin level bar beneath it.
Main
Application entry point for Stockroom.
SegmentedToggle
Row of square, equal-width segments of which exactly one is selected, such as the ALL / IN / LOW / OUT status filter.
SegmentedToggle.Segment
One custom-painted segment of the toggle.
SlipDialog
Undecorated, modal confirmation dialog styled as a paper slip.
SlipField
Labelled text input in the style of a paper entry slip.
SlipPanel
Panel painted as a paper slip: a surface-coloured sheet with a perforated, dashed tear-off edge near the top.
StampBadge
Table cell renderer that shows a StockStatus as a rubber stamp.
StockStatus
Stock level of an Item.
Theme
The "Stockroom Ledger" design system: every colour, font and shared painting helper used by the user interface.
Theme.FontHolder
Holds the loaded base fonts.
Toast
Short-lived notification styled as a printed receipt slip.
Toast.Kind
Kinds of toast, each with its own mark and edge.
UnderlineField
Transparent text input that draws only an underline, like a blank line on a paper form.
